C. Try to evaluate the effects of one change for 3 days before making another change in carbohy­
drates or insulin therapy.
Patients learn to adjust insulin and/or carbohydrate intake based on blood glucose levels. This 
estimate can be based on the number of carbohydrate exchanges or servings from the food groups 
that contain approximately 15 g of carbohydrate per carbohydrate serving (milk and yogurt (1 cup); 
starches: rice (⅓ cup cooked), potatoes, pasta, starchy vegetables (½ cup); breads (1 slice or 1 
ounce); cereals (¾ cup dry), and fruit and fruit juices (½ cup or 1 small)). A more precise estimate 
can be made from a detailed listing of the carbohydrate content of foods.
